identificationModule.officialTitle: Humanized CAR-T Therapy for Treatment of Recurrent or Refractory B Cell Malignancy by Targeting CD19

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: CD19 has been extensively evaluated as a therapeutic target for recurrent or refractory B cell malignancy by chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy, the single chain antibody sequence (scFv) against CD19 derived from a mouse hybridoma was widely employed. However, the immunogenicity of the mouse scFv sequence might be one of the reasons that CAR-T cells cannot persist in vivo for long. In present study investigators replace the mouse-derived scFv with a a humanized one and evaluate its safety and efficacy.

primaryOutcomes.measure: CAR-T cells persistence in peripheral blood
primaryOutcomes.description: The presence of CAR T cells in patients' peripheral blood will be quantified with real time qPCR

secondaryOutcomes.measure: B cell number and immunoglobulins in peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: The number of B cells and immunoglobulins in peripheral blood will be evaluated by routine methods

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age≥3 at the time of consent
* Survival time\>12 weeks
* B cell hematological malignancies by pathological examination
* Chemotherapy failure or recurrent B cell malignancy
* Creatinine\< 2.5mg/dl
* Glutamic-pyruvic transaminase, glutamic oxalacetic transaminase\< 3 fold of normal level
* Karnofsky Performance Status\>50% at the time of screening
* Bilirubin\<2.0mg/dl
* Adequate pulmonary, renal, hepatic, and cardiac function
* Fail in autologous or allogenic haemopoietic stem cell transplantation
* Free of leukocytes removal contraindications

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or nursing women
* Active hepatitis B, active hepatitis C, or any human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection at the time of screening
* Previous treatment with any gene therapy product
* Abnormal vital signs
* Highly allergic constitution or history of severe allergies, especially allergy to interleukin-2
* General infection or local severe infection, or other infection that is not controlled
* Dysfunction in lung, heart, kidney and brain.
* Severe autoimmune diseases
* other symptoms that are not applicable for CAR-T
